data.name: Aseelah
data.long_meaning: Aseelah is an Arabic name for girls that means protector or guardian. It is derived from the Arabic word 'aslh', which means to protect, shield, or shelter. This name conveys a sense of strength, security, and care, making it an ideal choice for parents who want to instill a sense of protection and guardianship in their child.
data.spiritual_meaning: Aseelah is a name that carries deep spiritual significance in Islamic tradition. It is believed to represent the protective nature of Allah (God) and the angels, who shield and guard believers from harm. The name Aseelah is a reminder of the presence and protection of the divine, and encourages one to have faith and trust in Allah's care and guidance.

People with this number are often creative, resourceful, and quick-thinking, and they have a natural ability to overcome obstacles and challenges. They may also have a strong sense of adventure and a desire to explore new experiences and ideas.

in_arabic.name: أسيلة
in_arabic.meaning: أسيلة تعني السؤال أو الاستفهام بلطف و رقة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم أسيلة مشتق من الفعل 'سأل' و يعني السؤال بطريقة لطيفة و رقيقة. و في اللغة العربية، يعتبر الاسم ذا معنى جميل و راقي. أسيلة هو اسم علم مؤنث يستخدم في العديد من الثقافات الإسلامية و يرمز إلى الفضيلة و الأدب.

in_urdu.name: اسیلا
in_urdu.meaning: اسیلا مطلب ہے سؤال کرنا یا استفسار کرنا
in_urdu.long_meaning: اسیلا نام کا مطلب ہے سؤال کرنا یا استفسار کرنا، جو عربی زبان کے الفاظ سے ماخوذ ہے۔ یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں اچھے اخلاق اور علم کی طلب کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: असीला
in_hindi.meaning: असीला का अर्थ है प्रश्न करना या पूछना
in_hindi.long_meaning: असीला नाम का अर्थ है प्रश्न करना या पूछना, जो संस्कृत और अरबी भाषा के शब्दों से लिया गया है। यह नाम मुस्लिम समुदाय में अच्छे आचरण और ज्ञान की महत्वाकांक्षा को दर्शाता है।

in_pashto.name: اسيلى
in_pashto.meaning: اسيلى د دې مطلب د پوښتنې يا استفسار
in_pashto.long_meaning: اسيلى نوم د عربي ژبې څخه اخستل شوی دی او د پوښتنې يا استفسار معنی لري. دا نوم د افغان او پښتون کلتور کې د ښو اخلاقو او پوهې د ترلاسه کولو لپاره کارول کېږي.

in_english.name: Aseelah
in_english.meaning: Aseelah means questioning or inquiry in a gentle manner
in_english.long_meaning: The name Aseelah is derived from the Arabic root 's-al' which means to question or inquire. It signifies a gentle and polite inquiry, reflecting good manners and a quest for knowledge. Aseelah is used in various Islamic cultures to denote a person with virtuous and inquisitive nature.

data.cultural_impact: The name Aseelah is rich in cultural significance as it reflects the values of protection, care, and guardianship that are deeply ingrained in many Islamic societies. By bestowing this name on a child, parents are expressing their hopes and aspirations that she will grow up to be a strong, caring, and protective individual. This name is also reminiscent of many Islamic figures who have acted as protectors and guardians, such as the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) who was a shield for his community, and the Imams who have protected Islam and its followers throughout history.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Aseelah lies in its reminder of the importance of being a guardian and protector, not just for oneself, but for others as well. This is in line with the Islamic principle of seeking the pleasure of Allah (swt) by serving and protecting innocent lives. The name Aseelah also evokes a deeper spiritual meaning, as it reminds us of the protective nature of Allah (swt) who guards and shields us from harm. Therefore, by giving their child the name Aseelah, parents are not only instilling a sense of responsibility and protective nature in their child, but also reminding them of the ultimate Protector and Guardian – Allah (swt).
